questions.question:
**Choose the option that is the passive form of the sentence.**

You have not yet responded to several of my complaints.

options.text: Several of my complaints you have not been responded to yet.
My complaints are not been responding yet by you.
Several of my complaints are not being responded yet.
Several of my complaints have not been responded to yet.

questions.solution:
Here the correct answer is **Several of my complaints have not been responded to yet.**

***__Key Points__**:-

__
 
• The given sentence is in the active voice, hence we need to convert it into the passive voice.
 
• Find the subject (You) and object (several of my complaints) of the sentence and exchange their places during transformation.
 
• **'You'** will be converted to** 'my'.**
 
• The given sentence is in the present perfect tense.
 
• The passive verb form for the present perfect is:-
 
 
• Has/have + been + past participle form of the verb.
 
 
 
• So, 'have not yet responded' changes to 'have not been responded to yet'.
 
• At last line up the remaining part.

 

Following these steps, we finally get - *Several of my complaints have not been responded to yet.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/11e549cb45ac78aca065082aa5a940b1d6506603cfff2fd1300a22049ad93dc6.png] .*

 
• The present perfect tense structure is 'has/have' + 'been' and *not 'has/have' + 'being'*__*.*
 
• You might think that **option 1 **is the correct answer but **'you'** is **redundant **in the option and therefore it is incorrect.

questions.question:
**Choose the option that is the active form of the sentence.**

I am sometimes puzzled by her actions.

options.text: Her actions are sometimes puzzled by me.
Her actions were sometimes puzzling me.

questions.solution:
Here the correct answer is **Her actions sometimes puzzle me.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**:- 

__
 
• The above-given sentence is in the passive voice.
 
• We need to change it into active voice:- 
 
• The subject 'I' becomes the object '**me**' of the active voice.
 
• The object 'her actions' becomes the subject of the active voice.
 
• Simple present tense changes in the following manner:-
 
 
• Passive Voice - is/am/are + V3
 
• Active Voice - (do/does + V1) or (V1 s/es)
 
 
 
• Thus,** 'am sometimes puzzled' **will be converted to** 'sometimes puzzle'.**

*Therefore, the correct active voice is Her actions sometimes puzzle me.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• When we convert active voice to passive voice, three things need to be kept in mind:-

 
 
• Change object into subject.
 
• Change subject into object.
 
• Always use the third form of the verb in passive voice.
 
• Use 'by' before the new object.
